verdict.rationale: Stable's own marketing describes background automation: mail is auto-routed to teams by keywords found in the mail or on the envelope, the AI inbox automatically sorts and routes mail, and check deposits can be automated. All of this is product-page language only; there is no documentation of how users configure rules, triggers or schedules. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation rules and triggers, details of what actions automations can take, recurring/scheduled automation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Auto-route mail to the right team based on key words found inside the mail, on the envelope, and more.
Your AI-powered inbox automatically sorts and routes your mail saving time and reducing errors.
Deposit: Automate check deposits and improve cash flow management.
Automate manual workflows and data extraction with our API, webhooks, and native integrations.
